subject: Pricing follow-up: token volumes and $/1M benchmarking
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing follow-up: token volumes and $/1M benchmarking

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for your time on the call today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can get you a tight pilot pricing proposal: 

Call recap (high level)
- Primary use: in-product conversational assistant + summarization for support tickets
- Expected profile: heavy short chat turns (user messages ~30-60 tokens, assistant 60-150 tokens) with occasional long-batch summarization jobs
- Key constraints: latency SLO for chat, cost sensitivity for high-volume requests

Questions for finalizing pricing:
1) Can you confirm expected monthly token volume (approx)? you mentioned ~4M-6M/day on call; is 120M/month a reasonable baseline?
2) What share is real-time chat vs async summarization (rough %)?
3) Do you have a target budget range for inference (monthly)? you mentioned $10k-$20k as a ballpark.
4) Any current effective $/1M tokens you're seeing today with OpenAI/Anthropic (so we can benchmark)?

Initial benchmarking note (very rough):
- OpenAI/Anthropic (managed APIs): generally higher list prices for newer large-capacity models (can be 3-9x higher than optimized hostings for open models)
- Open-model hosts / optimized private infra: can often push unit cost down significantly via quantization, batching, and KV caching

Attached is a one-page usage template (acme_usage_estimates.xlsx). Please fill in the monthly/peak numbers and current vendor rates if you have them. Once we have that, I'll run a short unit-economics model and share a targeted $/1M tokens comparison (Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic vs typical open-model hosts) and a proposed pilot price.

Next steps
- Sarah: send the filled usage estimate and any current invoices or effective rates
- Vanessa: will return a 1-2 page benchmark + suggested pilot pricing within 48 hours of receiving the worksheet

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: acme_usage_estimates.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token volumes and $/1M benchmarking

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below and I attached a small export of our recent usage.

Answers:
- Monthly volume: current production slice is ~120,000,000 tokens / month (approx). We expect 10-90% growth over next 6 months if pilot goes well.
- Chat vs async: roughly 80% real-time chat traffic, 20% async batch/summaries
- Budget range: target is ~$12k-$18k / month for inference; finance prefers we stay closer to $15k if possible.
- Current vendor: we have a mix; some burst traffic hits OpenAI and Anthropic depending on model. Our blended effective rate is hard to pull cleanly from invoices today, but rough effective spend is in the range of $350-600 per 1M tokens depending on model used.

Attached: acme_usage_report.csv (text/csv)

Goal: ideally we want something at or below ~$125 per 1M tokens for sustained traffic. That would make the project green based on our internal ROI.

Let me know if you need anything else and we're happy to run a short pilot.


Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Product | Acme Corp
sarah.lee@acme.com

Attachment: acme_usage_report.csv (text/csv)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token volumes and $/1M benchmarking

Hi Sarah — thanks for the fast response and for the export. I ran a short unit-econ pass with Marissa (cc'd) and pulled together a concise benchmarking summary and a proposed pilot rate. Key points below; attached is a 1-2 page pricing deck with the assumptions (redwood_pricing_deck.pdf).

Benchmark (baseline assumptions: 120M tokens / month, 80% chat, 20% batch summaries):
- OpenAI/Anthropic (current managed APIs): ~ $350-600 / 1M tokens (matches your estimate; depends on model and context window)
- Typical hosted open-model providers (no infra optimization): ~ $150-400 / 1M tokens (varies widely by model & infra)
- Redwood optimized hosting (quantization + batching + prefix caching): targeted range: $90-130 / 1M tokens for this workload if we commit to a 3-month pilot and enable standard optimizations

What that means for your budget:
- At $125 / 1M tokens (your target), 120M tokens ~= $15,000/month (within your $12-$18k range).
- Redwood pilot offer (suggested): $110 / 1M tokens for a 8-week pilot with a modest commit (we'll propose a capped monthly minimum to protect capacity). Pilot includes performance baseline testing, a small SLA window, and a short runbook for cutover.

Next steps (suggested):
1) If you're good with a pilot, we'll send a short SOW + pilot pricing (simple MSA addendum).
2) We'll schedule a 30-60 minute kickoff with infra + CSM to confirm perf SLOs and ingest the usage routing specifics.
3) If pilot numbers look good, convert to a 6-12 month committed plan with stepped pricing by volume.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_deck.pdf (application/pdf) — includes detailed assumptions and a simple sensitivity table comparing $/1M tokens vs expected monthly spend.

We can also provide a side-by-side CSV showing the math (what we charged vs your current blended rates) if that helps procurement. Marissa — can you confirm the pilot terms we discussed offline and draft the one-page SOW?

Thanks — I'll follow up with the SOW and a proposed kickoff timeslot.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_pricing_deck.pdf (application/pdf)
